_comment: Derived from claims.json, NOT hand-maintained. Every entry is keyed to a live claim id and regenerated from that claim's own text, so it cannot come to hold a term no claim supports — which is the Round 9 bug this closes. Regenerate with: pipelines/lib/claims.py synonyms
_why_a_sidecar: claims.json is out for Dr. Alptunaer's signature and its rendered PDF must keep matching the file that was sent, so nothing is written into it. Keying by claim id gives the same guarantee.
